verdicts.explanation: Section 2.2 states Li6.6Si0.6Sb0.4S5I reaches 9.9 × 10−3 S cm−1 at 25 °C from this work's EIS, with the 0.18 eV activation energy from the same fit. The 450 °C, 6 h anneal matches Section 4.1, and the null relative density is correct.

The text says 'the as-prepared Li6SbS5I exhibits an ionic conductivity of 1.5 × 10−5 S cm−1 at 25 °C' with no citation attached to this value; the cited 1.36 × 10−5 belongs to Li6PS5I, not this record. The 0.28 eV activation energy and the general 450 °C, 6 h synthesis also match.

field_errors.evidence: Fig. 2 caption: "(b) room-temperature ionic conductivity of Li6 SbS5 I, Li6.6 Si0.6 Sb0.4 S5 I, and Li6.75 Si0.75 Sb0.25 S5 I." Section 2.2 also states the conductivities were measured "at room temperature", and the same paragraph gives 25 °C.

verdicts.explanation: The material, value (8.1 × 10−3 S cm−1, Fig. 2(b)), and experimental origin are right, and the room-temperature condition is stated in the Fig. 2 caption, so the null temperature field should be filled with 25 °C rather than left null.
